description_en: Queries images that are available for Elastic High Performance Computing (E-HPC) clusters
description_zh: 获取E-HPC集群可用镜像列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-available-images --image-owner-alias self --instance-type ecs.c7.large --is-public true --hpc-inter-connect vpc --enable-ht true --scheduler Type=SLURM Version=22.05.8 --directory-service Type=NIS Version=1.0 --page-number 1 --page-size 1 --api-version 2024-07-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAvailableImages

parameters.help_en:
The image source. Valid values:

system: system image.
self: custom image.
others: shared image
parameters.help_zh:
镜像来源。取值范围：
system：系统镜像。
self：自定义镜像。
others：共享镜像
parameters.name: image_owner_alias

parameters.help_en:
The instance type.

By default, if you do not specify an instance type, the list of images that are supported by all instance types are queried. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
parameters.help_zh:
指定查询的实例规格。

如果不指定实例规格，则默认查询所有实例规格支持的镜像列表。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return published community images. Valid values:

true: returns published community images. If you set the value of this parameter to `true`, the `ImageOwnerAlias` parameter must be set to `others`.
false: returns non-community images. The value of the `ImageOwnerAlias` parameter prevails.

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询已发布的社区镜像。取值范围：

true：查询已发布的社区镜像。当您指定该参数值为`true`时，`ImageOwnerAlias`必须为`others`。
false：查询除社区镜像的其他镜像类型，具体以`ImageOwnerAlias`参数值为准。

默认值：false
parameters.name: is_public

parameters.help_en: The network type of the images that you want to query
parameters.name: hpc_inter_connect

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to return images in which hyper-threading is enabled
parameters.name: enable_ht

parameters.help_en: The scheduler information about the images that you want to query
parameters.name: scheduler

fields.help_en: The type of the domain account
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The version of the domain account service
fields.name: version

parameters.help_en: The information about the domain account service
parameters.name: directory_service

parameters.help_en: The page number of the page to return
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。 取值范围：1~50。 默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

Architecture.description_en:
The OS architecture of the image. Valid values:

x86_64
arm64
Architecture.description_zh:
操作系统架构。可能值：
x86_64
arm64

BootMode.description_en:
The boot mode of the image. Valid values:

BIOS: Basic Input/Output System (BIOS).
UEFI: Unified Extensible Firmware Interface (UEFI).

When you change the OS boot mode of an instance, you must make sure that the boot mode matches the boot mode of the associated image. Otherwise, the instance fails to be booted
BootMode.description_zh:
镜像的启动模式。可能值：

BIOS：BIOS启动模式。
UEFI：UEFI启动模式。

您需要了解指定的镜像支持的启动模式，当通过该参数修改启动模式后，必须与镜像本身支持的启动模式匹配，实例才能正常启动

ImageOwnerAlias.description_en:
The image source. Valid values:

system: system image.
self: custom image.
others: shared image
ImageOwnerAlias.description_zh:
镜像来源。可能值：

system：系统镜像。

self：自定义镜像。

others：共享镜像

Platform.description_en:
The OS. Valid values:

CentOS
windows
Platform.description_zh:
操作系统平台。可能值：
CentOS
windows

PageNumber.description_en:
The page number of the returned page.

Pages start from page 1.
Default value: 1
PageNumber.description_zh:
当前页码。

起始值为 1。
默认值为 1

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
执行命令并获取结果的过程是否成功。可能值：

true：成功。
false：失败

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
